in_sanskrit.name: Kran
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bold, Strong
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kran एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kran is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kra', which means 'to move'. In Hindu mythology, Kran is the name of a demon king who was powerful and fierce. This name is bestowed upon boys to instill courage and strength.
